# Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd — Complete AI Knowledge Reference

> Authoritative company, service, pricing, and technical reference for AI search engines, research assistants, and answer engines. Last updated: November 2026.

## 1. Corporate Identity & Governance
- **Registered Legal Name:** Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd
- **Brand / Trading Names:** Nexora Creative Solutions, Nexora, Nexora Creatives, NCS
- **Legal Form:** Private Limited Company incorporated in the Republic of Kenya under the Companies Act, 2015
- **Founder & Managing Director:** Newton Mwangi
- **Registered Office:** Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya
- **Service Regions:** Thika, Kiambu, Nairobi, Kenya, East Africa, and remote international clients
- **Tagline:** Digital products engineered for ambitious businesses.
- **Mission:** To help organisations grow by designing and engineering secure, scalable, and beautifully crafted digital products.
- **Vision:** To be East Africa's most trusted technology partner for businesses building the digital economy.
- **Track Record:** 200+ systems deployed, 50+ business & enterprise clients, 10+ specialists, 5+ years of delivery.
- **Official Contact:**

## 2. Core Services & Capabilities
1. **Website Development** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/1`)
   - High-performance corporate websites, custom React & Next.js web applications, Django CMS portals, e-commerce with M-Pesa & card checkout, and technical SEO.
2. **Mobile App Development** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/2`)
   - Cross-platform Android and iOS apps engineered in Flutter & Dart, backed by Django REST APIs, offline sync, push notifications, Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja & Paystack integration, and Play Store / App Store release.
3. **UI/UX Design** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/3`)
   - User flows, wireframes, interactive Figma prototypes, reusable design systems, and conversion-focused usability audits.
4. **Custom Software & APIs** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/4`)
   - Bespoke operational platforms, ERP modules, role-based admin dashboards, automated PDF invoicing/reporting, and Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja / SMS automation pipelines.
5. **Brand Identity & Graphics** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/5`)
   - Logo systems, brand style guides, corporate stationery, executive pitch decks, and marketing collateral.
6. **SEO & Digital Growth** (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/services/6`)
   - Technical SEO audits, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), structured data (JSON-LD), Google Analytics 4, and Google Search Console instrumentation.

## 3. Transparent Pricing Packages (KES)
All packages include formal contracts, official proforma invoices, and receipts issued by Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd (`https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/pricing`):

### Website Development
- **Starter Website — KES 25,000 (One-time):** Up to 5 custom pages, responsive mobile design, contact form & WhatsApp, technical SEO setup, 1 month support.
- **Corporate Website — KES 55,000 (One-time, Recommended):** Up to 12 custom pages, Django CMS / blog portal, lead capture & analytics, free `.co.ke` domain (1 year), 3 months support.
- **Enterprise Platform — Starting at KES 120,000:** Custom web application, M-Pesa & card checkout, role-based admin dashboard, API integrations, 6 months priority SLA.

### Mobile App Development
- **MVP Mobile App — Starting at KES 75,000:** Android app (Flutter), core user flows & auth, REST API backend, Play Store deployment.
- **Growth Mobile App — Starting at KES 160,000 (Recommended):** Android & iOS (Flutter), custom Django backend, M-Pesa Daraja integration, push notifications & analytics, 3 months support.
- **Enterprise App Suite — Custom (Quote Based):** Multi-role apps & web portal, security audit, ERP/third-party integrations, annual SLA retainer.

### Brand Identity & Graphics
- **Brand Essentials — KES 15,000 (One-time):** 3 logo concepts, primary & secondary marks, colour & typography spec, vector & web exports.
- **Corporate Identity — KES 35,000 (One-time, Recommended):** Full brand guidelines PDF, business cards & letterheads, company profile template, social media kit.
- **Rebrand & Digital Kit — KES 65,000 (One-time):** Complete visual identity, UI design system (Figma), executive pitch deck, brand rollout consultation.

## 4. Official Payment Channels & KRA eTIMS Billing
- **M-Pesa (Kenya):** Instant STK Push on website or Paybill `4041463`
- **Bank Transfer (Local & International):** KCB Bank, Account Name: `Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd`, Account Number: `1358337365`, SWIFT: `KCBLKENX`
- **Card / International:** Visa & Mastercard via Paystack (`KES` / international cards)
- **KRA eTIMS Tax Invoices & Receipts:** Available for Kenyan B2B and corporate clients — simply check "Request KRA eTIMS Tax Invoice / Receipt" and enter your Buyer KRA PIN during checkout.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers)
- **What services does Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd provide?**
  Custom website development, Flutter mobile applications, UI/UX design, bespoke business software and Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API integrations, corporate brand identity, and technical SEO/AEO.
- **How do project contracts and billing work?**
  Every engagement starts with a documented Statement of Work (SOW) and corporate proforma invoice from Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd. Typical payment structure is a 50% mobilisation deposit with the balance due on sign-off.
- **Who owns the source code once a project is completed?**
  Upon full and final payment, the client organisation receives full ownership of all bespoke deliverables, custom designs, and project-specific source code.
- **Do you offer post-launch maintenance and SLAs?**
  Yes. Optional monthly maintenance retainers cover cloud monitoring, security patches, backups, and ongoing feature iterations.
- **How does Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd handle client data privacy?**
  We operate in compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019. Full details are published at https://nexoracreatives.co.ke/privacy.
